parts.script:
Sarah: Hey Tom, did you finalize the plans for our hike this weekend?  
Tom: Not yet, but I was thinking we could start early Saturday morning. What do you think?  
Sarah: Sounds good! Do we have a trail in mind?  
Tom: I was looking at Pine Ridge Trail. It's about a five-mile loop.  
Sarah: Perfect! Is it suitable for beginners?  
Tom: Yes, it’s mostly flat but has some rocky areas. We’ll need to wear good hiking shoes.  
Sarah: Got it! And what about water and snacks?  
Tom: I think we should bring at least two liters of water each and some trail mix and sandwiches.  
Sarah: Great idea. Should we meet at your place around 7 AM?  
Tom: Yeah, that works. I’ll drive us there.  
Sarah: Awesome! I can’t wait. It’ll be nice to get outdoors and enjoy nature.  
Tom: Definitely, and don’t forget to charge your camera. The views are amazing!  
Sarah: Oh, right! I’ll make sure I do that.  
Tom: Cool, see you then!  
Sarah: See you!
